product.title: Doors Off West Maui and Molokai 45 minute Helicopter Tour

description.text: Soar above scenic Maui and Molokai on this unforgettable ‘doors off’ helicopter flight. Feel the island breeze in your hair as you enjoy the only doors-off helicopter flight on Maui, gliding above scenic vistas of towering waterfalls, sparkling rainbows, and unspoiled valleys thick with rainforest. Stops include Molokai, West Maui Mountains. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Maui's volcanoes, waterfalls, reefs, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
